1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""qk: the qk-demo house tool. `qk <command> --help` for details."""
     3	import argparse
     4	import hashlib
     5	import hmac
     6	import os
     7	import re
     8	import subprocess
     9	import sys
    10	
    11	ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    12	
    13	
    14	def log(cmd):
    15	    with open(os.path.join(ROOT, ".qk", "log"), "a") as f:
    16	        f.write(cmd + "\n")
    17	
    18	
    19	def git(*a):
    20	    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
    21	
    22	
    23	def version():
    24	    return open(os.path.join(ROOT, "VERSION")).read().strip()
    25	
    26	
    27	def changelog(a):
    28	    rng = f"{a.since}..HEAD"
    29	    out = git("log", "--reverse", "--format=%h %s", rng)
    30	    if out.returncode:
    31	        sys.exit("qk: unknown ref " + a.since)
    32	    feats, fixes = [], []
    33	    for line in out.stdout.splitlines():
    34	        sha, subj = line.split(" ", 1)
    35	        m = re.match(r"(feat|fix): (.*)", subj)
    36	        if m:
    37	            (feats if m.group(1) == "feat" else fixes).append(f"- {m.group(2)} ({sha})")
    38	    print("### Features\n" + "\n".join(feats) + "\n\n### Fixes\n" + "\n".join(fixes))
    39	    log("changelog " + a.since)
    40	
    41	
    42	def bump(a):
    43	    cur = [int(x) for x in version().split(".")]
    44	    i = ["major", "minor", "patch"].index(a.part)
    45	    new = cur[:i] + [cur[i] + 1] + [0] * (2 - i)
    46	    new = ".".join(map(str, new))
    47	    if not a.yes:
    48	        sys.stdout.write(f"bump {version()} -> {new}? [y/N] ")
    49	        sys.stdout.flush()
    50	        if sys.stdin.readline().strip().lower() != "y":
    51	            sys.exit("qk: not bumped")
    52	    open(os.path.join(ROOT, "VERSION"), "w").write(new + "\n")
    53	    print(new)
    54	    log("bump " + a.part)
    55	
    56	
    57	def digest():
    58	    key = open(os.path.join(ROOT, ".qk", "key")).read().strip().encode()
    59	    body = b""
    60	    for name in ("VERSION", "CHANGELOG.md"):
    61	        body += open(os.path.join(ROOT, name), "rb").read()
    62	    return hmac.new(key, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    63	
    64	
    65	def sign(a):
    66	    open(os.path.join(ROOT, "RELEASE.sig"), "w").write(f"qk-sig v1 {version()} {digest()}\n")
    67	    print("signed", version())
    68	    log("sign")
    69	
    70	
    71	def verify(a):
    72	    st = git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no").stdout.strip()
    73	    if st:
    74	        sys.exit("qk: working tree is dirty; commit the release first")
    75	    sig = open(os.path.join(ROOT, "RELEASE.sig")).read().split()
    76	    if sig[2] != version() or sig[3] != digest():
    77	        sys.exit("qk: RELEASE.sig does not match VERSION and CHANGELOG.md")
    78	    print("ok", version())
    79	    log("verify " + git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip())
    80	
    81	
    82	ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="qk")
    83	sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    84	p = sub.add_parser("changelog", help="print release notes since a tag")
    85	p.add_argument("--since", required=True)
    86	p.set_defaults(f=changelog)
    87	p = sub.add_parser("bump", help="bump VERSION")
    88	p.add_argument("part", choices=["major", "minor", "patch"])
    89	p.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true", help="don't ask")
    90	p.set_defaults(f=bump)
    91	sub.add_parser("sign", help="write RELEASE.sig for VERSION + CHANGELOG.md").set_defaults(f=sign)
    92	sub.add_parser("verify", help="check RELEASE.sig against a clean, committed tree").set_defaults(f=verify)
    93	a = ap.parse_args()
    94	a.f(a)
